hero.tagline: Traceable, wild-harvested botanicals and regional heritage crafts directly from the pristine altitudes of Uttarakhand.
hero.title: Global Wholesale of Authentic Himalayan Products
hero.lead: We bridge the gap between high-altitude agricultural heritage and commercial buyers. Source pure, unadulterated organic products—from wild-harvested sea buckthorn and nettle seeds to culturally rich Pahadi products and traditional Aipan handicrafts. Partner with us for a sustainable, transparent supply chain designed for luxury retail and enterprise procurement.
